about: Hand-picked routes and laps the AI can choose from. Lines come from GPX files the route owner exported (Komoot).

routes.name: Richmond Park lap
routes.desc: The full road circuit of Richmond Park, ridden anticlockwise. Rolling, with short climbs. Popular for laps and training.
routes.notes: Park roads have a 20mph limit; gates close at dusk.

routes.name: Richmond Park ballet lap
routes.desc: The shorter eastern loop inside Richmond Park, ridden anticlockwise. Flatter and quicker than the full lap.
routes.notes: Park roads have a 20mph limit; gates close at dusk.

routes.name: Box Hill climb
routes.desc: The classic Box Hill climb in Surrey up the Zig Zag Road: 2.7 km at about 5% (114 m), quiet, finishing at the viewpoint. Usually ridden once as part of a ride out to Box Hill, not as laps. There's a café near the top.
routes.notes: Quiet road; café near the top.

cafe.name: Café near the top of Box Hill

routes.name: Walton-on-Thames loop
routes.desc: An 85 km mostly flat road loop (about 340 m of climbing) into Surrey from south-west London: half of Richmond Park out to Kingston Gate, Hampton Court, Walton-on-Thames and the Woking area, back through Ockham, Cobham, Esher and Kingston, then the other half of Richmond Park. Quiet and slightly busier roads, but avoids main roads. Good for a long ride into Surrey.
routes.notes: Avoids main roads; the road between Cobham and Ockham can flood. Starts and finishes at The Clubhouse Café (Raptor Bikes).
routes.warn: road between Cobham and Ockham can flood

routes.name: Windsor Bun Run
routes.desc: The classic Windsor 'Bun Run': a very popular, mostly flat 84 km road loop (about 260 m of climbing) from Richmond Park to Windsor and back. Western half of Richmond Park to Kingston Gate, then Hampton Court, Sunbury, Shepperton and Chertsey, out through Virginia Water and Windsor Great Park to Windsor, home via Old Windsor, Runnymede and Egham, the same roads back to Kingston, and the eastern half of Richmond Park. Stops at the famous Cinnamon Café in Windsor. Good for a long, flat, sociable ride west.
routes.notes: THE café stop: Cinnamon Café in the old ticket hall at Windsor Royal station, opposite the castle (famous cinnamon buns, 10% off in cycling kit). Out via Virginia Water and Windsor Great Park, back via Old Windsor and Runnymede. Kingston to Chertsey is ridden both ways.
